content.name: Vardath - Kopis Production Cheat
content.description: Standalone superfast Kopis mobile resource factory and station build-storage feeder. Huge 3-way cargo and drone/crew capacities, custom laser with corrected 9.00 equipment-use ordering and verified gun recovery and without experimental turret socket. Maintains one player-owned Yaki-crewed Astrid, automatically replacing it near the player when lost or sold.
